The use of `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` ensures dependency lockfile consistency, reducing the risk of dependency confusion or drift. No network requests, dynamic code downloads, or suspicious file operations occur during the build or package stages.

All declared dependencies and tools (cargo, pnpm, nodejs) are necessary for building the frontend and Rust backend of a Tauri app. The package conflicts and provides fields correctly manage alternatives to avoid naming collisions.
